## GET /v1/jobs/{id}

Where a background job is. Ask again until `status` is `done` or `failed`;
`Retry-After` says how soon. A job and its result are kept for
`RUSTICDOC_JOB_TTL` after it ends, then removed.

Needs credentials, if any are configured.

### Parameters

| Name | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | Yes | The job's id, from the 202's body or Location |

### Responses

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The job | [`JobSchema`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#jobschema) |
| 404 | This caller has no such job, or it expired | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 501 | RUSTICDOC_STORE is not set | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 503 | The store cannot be reached | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |

## GET /v1/jobs/{id}/result

Downloads what a finished job made, as the request would have answered it.

Needs credentials, if any are configured.

### Parameters

| Name | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | Yes | The job's id |

### Responses

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The file | File |
| 404 | This caller has no such job, or it expired | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 409 | The job has not finished, or it failed | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 501 | RUSTICDOC_STORE is not set | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 503 | The store cannot be reached | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
